description: Search Europe PMC — a broader biomedical corpus than PubMed that also indexes preprints (bioRxiv, medRxiv), patents, and agricultural/biomedical databases. Unlike search_pubmed, each result includes an abstract snippet, citation count, open-access status, and whether a preprint. Use preprintsOnly to surface work ahead of formal publication.

query.description: Search query (Europe PMC query syntax supported, e.g. field tags like AUTH, TITLE, JOURNAL)

sort.description: Sort order: relevance, date (newest first), or cited (most cited first)

name: search_europepmc
